newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman on Bankers Trust.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman on Bankers Trust.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs said it added Bankers Trust New York Corp to the firm's recommended list and that the company is "in the midst of a major earnings turnaround."

-- Goldman noted Bankers Trust has "several potentially strong growth products, targetted to a global but defined client base, in which equivalent product competitiors are not nearly as numerous as in commercial banking more broadly defined."

-- Goldman cited Bankers Trust's emergence as an "investment bank powerhouse in the high-yield customer sector," its strong reputation in derivatives, a "healthy turnaround in its U.S. investment management activities," and valuation.
